panels.title: Alerts and bans

targets.expr: sum by (machine) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" [$__interval]))

sum(count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | decision="ban" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Alerts by reporting machine, and bans.

targets.expr: sum by (reason, outcome) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | label_format outcome=`{{ if .decision }}ban{{ else }}alert{{ end }}` [$__range]))

topk(10, sum by (country) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | country!="" [$__range])))

topk(10, sum by (asn) (count_over_time({job="crowdsec/crowdsec-lapi"} |= "module=db" |= " by ip " | regexp `msg="\((?P<machine>[a-z0-9-]+?)(?:-[0-9a-f]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5})?(?:/[^)]*)?\) (?:alert : )?(?P<reason>\S+) by ip (?P<ip>\S+) \((?P<country>[A-Z]*)/(?P<asn>\d*)\)(?: : (?P<duration>\S+) (?P<decision>\S+) on)?` | reason=~"$scenario" | asn!="" | asn!="0" | label_format asn="AS{{.asn}}" [$__range])))
